acceptances.given: The complete current Consumer Manifest and current repository caller set are available for reconciliation.

oracle.expected: Bidirectional reconciliation covers the complete Manifest and the VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing caller surfaces.
forbidden: Omission of VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing callers.
oracle.observable: The reconciliation result records both Manifest-to-caller and caller-to-Manifest coverage.

acceptances.then: The complete Consumer Manifest is mutually reconciled with repository callers.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Use the frozen FR-9 pytest selector with a case that omits or adds a VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing caller on only one side of the reconciliation.

slice_hints.behavior_change: Reconcile the complete current Consumer Manifest bidirectionally with repository callers, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing call surfaces.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Consumer routes and derived-artifact non-authority; reconciliation must not remove supported VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing callers.

slice_hints.state_transition: Unreconciled current Consumer Manifest and caller surface -> bidirectionally reconciled complete current Consumer Manifest and caller surface.
slice_hints.terminal_predicate: The FR-9 reconciliation test establishes reverse and forward coverage for every current Manifest entry and every VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing caller.
